unresolvedMaterialFindings.title: Required runtime entry pins absent
unresolvedMaterialFindings.evidence: I independently inspected actual package exports and the61-pin manifest. It pins midnight-js-contracts package.json and index.d.mts, but not runtime dist/index.mjs. Ledger-v8 advertises node entry midnight_ledger_wasm_fs.js, while declared pins include only package.json and ledger-v8.d.ts. Several providers likewise lack runtime entry hashes.
unresolvedMaterialFindings.impact: Packet03 mandates runtime entry verification without parent-approved expected digests for all selected imports. A type declaration digest cannot verify executing code. An author-computed runtime hash cannot establish preauthor input authority.
unresolvedMaterialFindings.correction: Parent must resolve present selected entries and freeze their digests in an expanded candidate-bound manifest before author admission. Reject unsupported/missing exports. Do not install or download.
unresolvedMaterialFindings.judgmentHistory: I initially treated extra entry digests as an implementation evidence obligation. Parent clarified author self-attestation is inadmissible. The final verdict preserves that correction and blocks03.
